researcher_notes:
Listed against 14 JANUARY. Four peer UK institutions (Cambridge, LSE, Imperial, Edinburgh) all publish 13 January 2027 as the equal consideration date for 2027 entry. 14 January was the 2026-entry date. Glasgow's page is undated, so this is most likely a stale carry-over rather than a genuine institutional difference - but both readings are recorded and neither is chosen here.

RESOLUTION 2026-08-22 (see docs/research/requirement-conflicts/12-glasgow-equal-consideration-date.md): RESOLVED against the owner of the fact, exactly as this row's own limitations instructed. The equal consideration deadline is the date an application must ARRIVE AT UCAS, published by UCAS as a dated cycle event; no university sets it. UCAS's 2027-entry page gives 18:00 UK on 13 January 2027 (already VERIFIED_CURRENT in deadlines_batch3 line 1, and Glasgow's correct value is recorded at deadlines_batch3 line 3). Re-fetched 2026-08-22: Glasgow's page still shows an undated '14 January' with no last-updated date, while correctly showing 15 October for medicine/dentistry/veterinary/Oxbridge — a UCAS calendar copy with one figure left behind. CONFIRMING DETAIL: UCAS's mid-January deadline falls on a Wednesday, and 14 Jan 2026 and 13 Jan 2027 are both Wednesdays, so Glasgow is carrying the 2026-entry figure one cycle stale. NOT resolved by peer majority — four peers publishing the 13th are four restatements of one UCAS figure, not four independent witnesses. A student applying on 14 January 2027 would have missed equal consideration by a day. ALSO WORTH CHECKING: this page's other UCAS-derived dates (6 May and 3 June reply-by, 30 June final application) were not verified in this pass; if one figure is a cycle stale, the rest deserve checking.
